scope: Implementation detail of preregistered limited fit/inner shortlist; no new action, loss, threshold or scientific gate.
proposal_K: On the single inner sequence, choose the K in [1,3,5] with highest naturally beneficial action proposal recall; prefer smaller K on an exact tie. One K shared by all controller comparisons in that fold.
learned_approval_shortlist: For each controller/loss ensemble evaluate the preregistered 12 approval combinations on inner counterfactual labels. Rank by mean actual H5 value of the predicted highest-value approved action per identity/frame, with KEEP=0 for abstention. Retain top two unique combinations plus conservative [0.9,0.1,0.05]. Then select using actual inner full-sequence TrackEval and the preregistered DetA guard; counterfactual utility is not the final HOTA selector.
fixed_weight: Run all five preregistered strengths [0.5,1,2,4,8] with genuine current forced-edge approval, not an additive score tape.
memory_selection: Report the full actual inner Pareto frontier. Prefer policies jointly meeting wrong_rate<=0.02 and retention>=0.60. If no safe active memory exists, joint authority uses P0 and reports no memory safety success; do not bless zero writes.
bonus_controls: All global scalar discounts [0,0.25,0.5,1] plus real fit-only identity-conditioned native reliability. Positive-only reliability is NOT_RUN if actual source positive-history activation remains zero; do not synthesize positive constraints.
structured_components: Explicit target/future gain, competitor damage and potential memory-risk supervision, retained separately from utility.
temporal_feature_definition: Action feature native_streak is memory confirmation history: inactive (zero) under P0/P1/P2, matching frozen action mining. Native/write reliability classifiers use separately tracked actual observation streak. No future confirmation enters current action features.
outer: Freeze policy, model/checkpoint SHA, proposal K, native configuration, memory configuration and thresholds for every family before outer labels/metrics. Three-seed diagnostics use frozen ensemble-selected thresholds, never outer selection.
val: Closed until strict development gate passes. Historical VAL exposure does not make new VAL tuning permissible.
